outcome: Complications (organ damage, bleeding, de novo incontinence, voiding dysfunction, intestinal obstruction, defecation disorder, infection, urinary infection)
cohort: 501 women who underwent laparoscopic pectopexy across 11 clinics and by 13 surgeons in four European countries.
finding: Laparoscopic pectopexy in clinical routine resulted in severe complications in 1% of cases, primarily related to concomitant procedures or adhesions, with comparable operating times to sacrocolpopexy.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was performed in 5.6% of patients.
